# Vignesh Murali

> Vignesh Murali is a product designer who works with startups, agencies, and teams across markets to design clear digital products, websites, and apps.

The portfolio focuses on product and UX/UI design for SaaS and web, mobile app design, prototypes, and design systems. Vignesh's work connects user needs to business goals such as usability, conversion, and growth. Based in Bangalore, India; available to work with teams worldwide.

## Portfolio

- [Selected work](https://vigneshmurali.com/#work): Portfolio projects across product, SaaS, web, app, branding, and motion design.
- [Product design](https://vigneshmurali.com/#disciplines): Product and UX/UI design, including a Deepvue analytics dashboard redesign.
- [About and experience](https://vigneshmurali.com/#about): Background, capabilities, design process, and featured writing.
- [Contact](https://vigneshmurali.com/#contact): Contact Vignesh about freelance or full-time opportunities.

## Writing and posts

- [Writing, posts and features](https://vigneshmurali.com/writing/): Everything Vignesh writes and shares across platforms, with summaries.
- [From 15 to 20 days to hours: automating lifecycle design with n8n, Claude and Figma](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:share:7514742888027807745/): LinkedIn post on an n8n workflow where a Claude agent extracts brand tokens, Slack gates approval and a Figma agent builds email layouts.
- [Claude for Startups: a resource for early-stage AI founders](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:share:7514189422565924864/): LinkedIn post on the Claude for Startups program by Anthropic.
